user.title: Connect EZVIZ Cloud
user.description: Sign in to your EZVIZ Cloud account and choose the API region. If you select Custom, enter the url (without https://).

user_mfa_confirm.title: Two-factor verification required
user_mfa_confirm.description: Enter the SMS verification code sent by EZVIZ.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: Your session expired or became invalid. Enter your password to refresh tokens. You may be asked for an SMS code next.

reauth_mfa.title: Re-authenticate: SMS code
reauth_mfa.description: Enter the SMS verification code to finish re-authentication.

error.invalid_url: Custom API host is invalid. Enter a hostname without https:// or trailing slash.
error.mfa_required: Multi-factor authentication required, please enter the code
error.verification_required: Verification code required or invalid. Please try again.
error.invalid_timeout: Timeout must be a whole number between 1 and 300 seconds.
error.cannot_save_credentials: The login could not be saved safely. Check storage and try again.

abort.ezviz_cloud_account_missing: Ezviz cloud account missing. Please reconfigure Ezviz cloud account
abort.no_cameras: No cameras were found for this account.

cloud.title: Cloud Settings
cloud.description: Set default options for the EZVIZ cloud account.

camera_edit.title: Camera settings
camera_edit.description: Editing camera {serial} at {ip_address}. Set RTSP credentials for this camera. If you don't know them, choose "fetch_my_key" and provide one-time codes on the next step if prompted.

data.rtsp_uses_verification_code: Use verification code for RTSP (instead of encryption key)
data.ephemeral_test_rtsp: Test RTSP now (wakes device and probes stream)

camera_edit_2fa.title: One-time codes
camera_edit_2fa.description: Enter one-time codes for {serial} at {ip_address} to fetch verification/encryption keys.

error.device_exception: Device error while testing the camera's RTSP credentials.
error.verification_required: Verification code required or invalid. Please try again.
error.invalid_timeout: Timeout must be a whole number between 1 and 300 seconds.
error.options_changed: Camera settings changed while this form was open. Review the current values and submit again.
error.verification_code_fetch_failed: EZVIZ could not retrieve the verification/sticker code. Any encryption key already fetched is retained in this form. Saved credentials are unchanged; keep the existing verification code or retry later.
error.encryption_key_fetch_failed: EZVIZ could not retrieve the encryption key. Saved credentials are unchanged; keep the existing key or retry later.

abort.integration_unavailable: Load the EZVIZ integration before editing camera settings. Cloud options remain available.

wake_device.name: Wake camera
wake_device.description: This can be used to wake the camera/device from hibernation.

capture_picture.name: Capture picture
capture_picture.description: Take a new picture through the EZVIZ cloud and show it in the snapshot image entity. Works without RTSP and wakes battery devices from standby.

request_forbidden.message: {operation} failed: EZVIZ denied permission ({detail}). For a shared device, ask the owner to review Account → Family & Guests and test the same action in the EZVIZ app with this account. Some devices or shared accounts may not support this operation.

request_timeout.message: {operation} failed: the EZVIZ request timed out ({detail}). This may be temporary; a timeout alone does not require a restart or reauthentication.

request_connection.message: {operation} failed: could not connect to EZVIZ ({detail}).
